author: GretchenMarina
text: It’s a privilege to study DALL·E 2. I want to thank the team, including @model_mechanic @prafdhar @unixpickle @caseychu9 @markchen90 for reaching out and engaging with us to discuss these topics with us all the way back in Summer of ‘20 !

author: GretchenMarina
text: New risks arise at the intersection of text and image modalities, and at the points where DALL·E 2 interacts with other AI systems, human/AI systems, and humans. With a set of trusted users, we have an opportunity to learn more about these - and a responsibility to do so safely.

author: GretchenMarina
text: Increasingly capable and steerable multimodal models present risks of harm to users and non-users from disinformation, stereotyping, disparate performance, spurious toxic content, economic impact, lack of inclusion, and misuse involving hate, harassment, and violence.

author: GretchenMarina
text: In the doc, we share preliminary findings on potential risks of DALL·E 2 and the DALL·E 2 Preview system, informed by our work and red teaming with a host of researchers, and touch briefly on how DALL·E 2 compares with, and might be combined with, existing technologies.
